name: Scroll of Pyro Firestorm 🔥
description: An ancient fire magic scroll. Deals massive fire damage and ignites enemies, dealing 6 damage/turn for 4 turns. Consumes 20 MP to cast on any enemy in sight.

combos.logMessage: was Frozen/Chilled, and your Scroll Inferno vaporized the ice! Deals +20 bonus damage!
was Poisoned, and your Scroll Inferno ignited the noxious fumes! Deals +20 bonus damage!

successMsgText: 📜 [ARCANUM CRAFT]: You fuse an Obsidian Glass Shard and a Pyrotactile Fire Catalyst into a glowing Scroll of Pyro Firestorm!

name: Scroll of Tide Wave 🌊
description: A high-tier water/ice magic scroll. Deals high frost damage and freezes enemies, dealing 3 damage/turn and slowing them for 3 turns. Consumes 20 MP to cast on any enemy in sight.

combos.logMessage: was Burning, and your Tidal Wave rapidly cooled their flesh! Deals +20 bonus damage!

successMsgText: 📜 [ARCANUM CRAFT]: You fuse an Iron Alloy Ore and a Cryo-forged Ice Catalyst into a crystal-clear Scroll of Tide Wave!

name: Scroll of Noxious Swarm ☣️
description: A noxious alchemical scroll. Deals high poison damage and severely poisons enemies, dealing 4 damage/turn for 5 turns. Consumes 20 MP to cast on any enemy in sight.

combos.logMessage: was Burning, and your Noxious Swarm triggered a volatile combustion! Deals +20 bonus damage!

successMsgText: 📜 [ARCANUM CRAFT]: You weave Driftwood Timber and a Venom-stung Gas Catalyst into a toxic-vapored Scroll of Noxious Swarm!
